projects.title: Marble and basketweave bathroom
projects.blurb: Marble-effect porcelain walls, a black-and-white basketweave mosaic floor, matte black fittings, lit shower niches and a frameless corner shower.
projects.description: This beautiful marble and basketweave bathroom renovation was completed in 2026. The bathroom itself took just seven working days to complete. We were undertaking two bathroom renovations simultaneously, successfully completing both projects within just two weeks and three days, from the initial strip-out to the final handover. Careful planning, efficient coordination and attention to detail allowed us to deliver both bathrooms to a high standard within an impressive timeframe.

projects.title: Loft bathroom with freestanding bath
projects.blurb: A freestanding bath under the dormer windows, a lit recess, white metro tiles and a bold geometric floor, with a separate glass shower.
projects.description: This high-quality loft bathroom renovation showcases exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail throughout. The stunning freestanding bath creates a luxurious focal point, complemented by beautifully finished tiling, precise installation and carefully executed detailing. Every aspect of the renovation was thoughtfully planned and professionally completed to make the best use of the loft space. Despite the complexity of working within a loft, we completed the entire renovation in just nine working days, delivering a beautiful, high-end finish without compromising on quality.

projects.title: Dark marble and brushed brass
projects.blurb: Large-format dark marble-effect tiles floor to ceiling, brushed brass brassware and towel rail, a wall-hung WC and a glass-screened bath.
projects.description: This stunning dark marble and brushed brass bathroom renovation showcases exceptional workmanship, precision and attention to detail. The dramatic marble finishes create a luxurious, sophisticated look, beautifully complemented by the brushed brass fittings and contemporary sanitaryware. Particular care was taken with the alignment and finishing of the large-format marble tiles, ensuring a seamless, high-end appearance throughout. Every detail was carefully considered and expertly installed to achieve a flawless finish. The complete renovation was delivered in just nine working days, without compromising on quality or craftsmanship.

projects.title: Marble bathroom with lit shelf
projects.blurb: White marble-effect porcelain, a long LED-lit shelf above the bath, brass fittings and a softly lit floating WC.
projects.description: This elegant marble bathroom renovation showcases exceptional craftsmanship, precision and attention to detail. The large-format marble-effect slabs were expertly installed to create a beautiful, seamless finish, with carefully matched veining throughout. A standout feature is the bespoke illuminated recessed shelving, incorporating integrated LED lighting to create both a practical storage solution and a stunning design feature. Combined with premium brass fittings, contemporary fixtures and carefully positioned lighting, every element was finished to the highest standard. The result is a luxurious, timeless bathroom where quality workmanship and attention to detail are evident in every aspect.

projects.title: Green loft shower room
projects.blurb: Deep green walls over white metro tiles, a round LED mirror, open shelving under the eaves and a walk-in shower.
projects.description: This beautifully designed green loft shower room is a great example of transforming an awkward loft space into a stylish and highly functional bathroom. The combination of deep green walls, classic metro tiles and bespoke shelving creates a distinctive, contemporary look while making excellent use of the available space. Particular attention was given to the precise tiling, clean finishes and careful installation of all fixtures and fittings. The illuminated round mirror and modern vanity unit complete the design, adding character and elegance. The result is a beautifully finished shower room, delivered with exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail.

projects.title: Blue-tiled walk-in shower
projects.blurb: Hand-finished blue wall tiles in a walk-in shower, marble-effect floor, a blue vanity and a lit recess behind the bath.
projects.description: This contemporary blue-tiled walk-in shower showcases excellent craftsmanship and meticulous attention to detail. The rich blue tiles create a striking, elegant finish, with carefully aligned grout lines and precise detailing throughout. The spacious walk-in shower features a modern rainfall shower system, complemented by high-quality fixtures and fittings. Particular care was taken with the waterproofing, tiling and installation to ensure a flawless finish that is both beautiful and built to last. The result is a stylish, practical shower space finished to an exceptionally high standard.

projects.title: Botanical cloakroom

Particular attention was paid to the precision of the wallpaper installation, ensuring the pattern flows beautifully around the room and creates a seamless, luxurious effect. Every detail was carefully considered and expertly executed, resulting in a unique, characterful cloakroom with a beautiful high-end finish.

projects.title: Shower-over-bath refit
